entries.claim: 牛奶和乳制品消费可改善睡眠质量，表现为匹兹堡睡眠质量指数（PSQI）总分显著降低。
entries.source_doc: The Consumption of Milk or Dairy Products and Sleep Quality: A Systematic Review and Meta- Analysis

entries.claim: 健康成人摄入牛奶或乳制品可改善睡眠质量（降低PSQI总评分）。
entries.source_doc: The Consumption of Milk or Dairy Products and Sleep Quality: A Systematic Review and Meta- Analysis

entries.claim: 消费乳制品与睡眠时间增加0.669小时（约40分钟）相关。
entries.source_doc: The Consumption of Milk or Dairy Products and Sleep Quality: A Systematic Review and Meta- Analysis

entries.claim: 消费鲜奶与睡眠时间增加0.160小时（约9.6分钟）相关。
entries.source_doc: The Consumption of Milk or Dairy Products and Sleep Quality: A Systematic Review and Meta- Analysis

entries.claim: 定期食用乳制品对睡眠质量有有益影响（降低PSQI评分）。
